preconditions.description: The number of forbidden prefix products n must be non-negative and less than the modulus m, with both within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x < m for x in forbidden_products)
preconditions.description: All forbidden prefix products must be distinct integers between 0 and m - 1.
The length of the list of forbidden prefix products must match the given number n.

postconditions.description: The length of the output sequence must be equal to the number k printed on the first line.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= x < m for x in sequence)
postconditions.description: Each element in the sequence must be an integer between 0 and m - 1, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(prefix_product % m not in forbidden_products for prefix_product in prefix_products)
postconditions.description: No prefix product of the sequence modulo m can appear in the list of forbidden prefix products.
All prefix products of the sequence modulo m must be distinct.
